summary: Act 2 (San Francisco) scenery for v3 is finished and verified; nothing was committed by me (the lead's checkpoints fc7dfe5 and earlier contain the work). Layout, colliders, traffic and timings are unchanged: every visual builder keeps the city's single random sequence intact, so parked cars and solids stay at v2's 224 and 230. What changed: (1) the v2 'kind' uber-shader is now a branch-free TSL material on two 18-layer PBR texture arrays generated by tools/tex/city_tex.py (siding, shingles, fish-scale, asphalt with cracks and tar seals, sidewalk slabs, brick, planks, painted metal with chips, dentil mouldings, stone, canvas, tar roof, concrete, ground, window sash, manhole). It does derivative-frame normal mapping, anti-tiling, asphalt repair patches, worn road paint, clustered puddles with ripples and SSR, interior-mapped windows (rooms, curtains, blinds, lit or dark) and shop fronts with shelves; (2) alpha-tested foliage cards for street and park trees, palms and conifers, which cast dappled shadows, sway in the wind and glow when backlit; (3) a new golden-hour TSL sky (belt of Venus, Mie glow, domain-warped lit altocumulus, limb-darkened HDR sun); (4) the bay: analytic sky reflection, more wave layers, glitter, foam from scene depth around piles and the sea wall, SSR; (5) CSM sun shadows (3 cascades) on Ultra and Élevé, a single shadow map on Moyen and Économie, switched by K.gfx; (6) ornamental lamps with light cones, hydrants, house details (cornice brackets, chimneys, closed window hoods, door panels), a detailed red bridge (ribbed towers, art-deco struts, Warren truss, steel suspenders, deck paint, railings and lamps), the bumper (chrome, clearcoat red, chasing neon ring and bulbs, gold dome; v2's gap under the dome is filled), gold physical rings, dash-hoop portals and a painted goal pad; (7) per-side-street LOD so Moyen meets its budget. Verified: full private WebGL 2 e2e 80/80 plus the Moyen builder target, act2 and regress2 19/19 on the final build, WebGPU suite 6/6, and ./build.sh. Screenshots were checked on Élevé, Ultra, phone Moyen and WebGPU, and against the v2 Act 2 viewpoints.

regress2 'no lawn-stripe seam' (Act 1, world area) is flaky in my private builds. It also fails with the pre-city dd50f78 25-city.js, so the city does not cause it.
The 'shaded Act 2 streets readable' check depends on the post grade: with the old city and the current post it failed (63/71). The city now meets it. Re-run regress2 if the grade changes.

Post (optional): looking straight into the low sun (waterfront heading west) the glare and godrays wash the frame with a cyan cast; the old city shows the same. Very close emissive car lights get a strong blue lens ghost on Ultra.
e2e screenshot frames (24-29) are rendered after unrendered ticks, so velocity motion blur is exaggerated there. This is a harness artefact, not the game.
known_issues: Asphalt in direct low sun shows a fairly coarse aggregate relief at grazing angles (normal strength kept moderate for the luma check balance).
The far background city is still boxes with a procedural window grid (improved frames and lit windows, but no new geometry).
Lamp light cones are subtle at golden hour (sun still up) and there are no real lamp lights or ground pools, which keeps the shaded-street luma check safe.
If the city strips arrive late (slow network), the city first shows per-layer mean colours (no detail) for a moment, then the textures swap in without stalling.
Vehicles are still the v2 boxes (vehicles role, runs after me).
